hook.en: Should a child learn to read because it will make her a better worker, or because reading is part of a good life? Economists answer this in two ways.
hook.kn: ಮಗು ಓದಲು ಕಲಿಯುವುದು ಉತ್ತಮ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕಳಾಗಲು ಎಂದೋ, ಓದುವುದು ಉತ್ತಮ ಜೀವನದ ಭಾಗ ಎಂದೋ? ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞರು ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ರೀತಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

objectives.en: Distinguish human capital and human development
Name the bodies that regulate education and health in India
State the problems of HCF in India

narration.en: Should a child learn to read because it will make her a better worker, or because reading is part of a good life? Economists answer this in two ways.
narration.kn: ಮಗು ಓದಲು ಕಲಿಯುವುದು ಉತ್ತಮ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕಳಾಗಲು ಎಂದೋ, ಓದುವುದು ಉತ್ತಮ ಜೀವನದ ಭಾಗ ಎಂದೋ? ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞರು ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ರೀತಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

body.en: Human capital treats education and health as a means to increase labour productivity; any investment in them is unproductive if it does not raise output. Human development is based on the idea that education and health are integral to human well-being, because they give people the ability to make choices; they are ends in themselves. Basic education and health are important whether or not they raise productivity.
body.kn: ಮಾನವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯವನ್ನು ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಸಾಧನವೆಂದು ನೋಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಾನವ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಅವನ್ನು ಮಾನವ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣದ ಅವಿಭಾಜ್ಯ ಅಂಗ, ಸ್ವತಃ ಗುರಿ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Human capital: means to an end (productivity)

Basic education and health are important whether or not they raise productivity.

title.en: On the board: Means or ends?

say.en: The human capital view treats education and health as means to raise output.
Human development treats them as ends in themselves: they widen people's choices.
Education is regulated by NCERT, UGC and AICTE; health by the ministry and ICMR.
Rising population thins out facilities: 30,000 beds for 120 lakh people is 250 per lakh, for 150 lakh only 200.

body.en: In India, education and health are the responsibility of both the Union and the state governments. The Ministry of Education and bodies such as NCERT, UGC and AICTE regulate education; the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and ICMR regulate health. Problems include rapidly rising population, which reduces the facilities available per person, and brain drain, the migration of highly skilled people abroad.
body.kn: ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸರ್ಕಾರಗಳ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ. ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ, ಎನ್‌ಸಿಇಆರ್‌ಟಿ, ಯುಜಿಸಿ, ಎಐಸಿಟಿಇ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು; ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯ ಮತ್ತು ಐಸಿಎಂಆರ್ ಆರೋಗ್ಯವನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯಾ ಏರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿಭಾ ಪಲಾಯನ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳು.

points.en: Education: Ministry of Education, NCERT, UGC, AICTE
Health: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, ICMR
Brain drain: skilled people migrating abroad

narration.en: In India, education and health are the responsibility of both the Union and the state governments. The Ministry of Education and bodies such as NCERT, UGC and AICTE regulate education; the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and ICMR regulate health. Problems include rapidly rising population, which reduces the facilities available per person, and brain drain, the migration of highly skilled people abroad.
